citation.authors: Panahi Y, Taghizadeh M et al

cited_by.title: Hair growth oils and supplements: castor, rosemary, black seed, biotin

record.population: 100 Iranian patients with androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss)
record.design: Randomised comparative trial: rosemary oil against minoxidil 2%, 6 months
record.finding: No significant change at 3 months in either group. At 6 months both groups had a significant rise in hair count, with no significant difference between them. Scalp itching was higher in both groups than at baseline and more frequent with minoxidil.
record.note: No placebo or untreated group. Participants were selected for pattern hair loss, not for afro-textured hair.
